articleBodyHtml:
Initiating Activities

The group began by suggesting to light a fire, with some members expressing agreement. This was followed by a discussion about starting an animation, which was met with enthusiasm and approval.

They eventually decided to start the animation, with one member offering to keep it simple for better animation quality. This decision was supported by others in the group.
